program_model.instance_model: one layered-acrylic ADA system across room/restroom/stair/elevator + insert-window subtype

knowledge.plain_language_summary: A layered ADA system: 1/16in P99 non-glare acrylic 2nd-surface painted over a 1/4in painted acrylic, with 1/32in white Rowmark ADA-Alternative tactile, clear Raster braille embedded in the lens, VHB; glass-mount variant adds a 3M dark-gray backer; an A2 subtype has a CNC-milled insert pocket for changeable copy.
knowledge.rationale: A stacked non-glare/painted-acrylic build with embedded Raster braille is the compliant civic standard; wall and glass mounting plus an insert subtype cover all conditions.

compliance.notes: Grade-2 Raster braille; non-glare lens; wall + glass mount.
